title: Plan Allocation
description: One slice of a plan along a breakdown dimension: a market, a station, a programming format, a daypart, a week or a spot length. Figures are point estimates for the slice as scheduled; the proposal's forecast carries ranges and remains authoritative where both state the same metric. Every row reports the same figures within one breakdown where it can, and a seller omits the rest, and a buyer MUST NOT read an omitted figure as zero.

key.description: Seller-assigned identifier of the slice, unique within its breakdown and stable across the proposal versions of one negotiation so a buyer can compare a slice between versions.

label.description: Human-readable name of the slice, such as 'Boston, MA' or 'AM Drive'.

within.description: The slice of another breakdown this one belongs to, such as the market a station sits in.

metro.description: Typed reference for a market slice, in the same shape as targeting_overlay.geo_metros.

identifiers.description: Identifiers for a station slice, of type station_id or facility_id.

programming_format.description: The seller's programming-format code for a programming_format slice.

daypart.description: Typed time window for a daypart slice.

week.description: A week slice: its 1-based index within the flight and its dates.

duration_seconds.description: Spot length in seconds for a spot_length slice.

budget.description: Spend allocated to the slice, in the breakdown currency.

impressions.description: Estimated impressions in the plan's target audience that the slice delivers.

grps.description: Estimated gross rating points the slice contributes to the plan, rated against the plan's audience_basis.universe, so contributions sum to the plan total. A local rating against the slice's own population is a different figure and is not carried here.

cpp.description: Effective cost per point: budget / grps, in the breakdown currency.

cpm.description: Effective cost per thousand impressions: budget / impressions * 1000, in the breakdown currency.

composition_rate.description: Share of the slice's population (a market) or audience (a station) that falls in the plan's target audience, 0 to 1. Measured, so a rate. The denominator differs by dimension, so compare it only between slices of one dimension.

index.description: Concentration of the target audience in the slice relative to audience_basis.index_baseline, where 100 equals the baseline. Compare it only between slices of one dimension.

target_persons.description: Target-audience persons in the slice (the slice's population in the target demographic, not delivered reach), in audience_basis.reach_unit.
